answer: Require every agent identity to post a refundable stake that is locked while it trades, so creating thousands of fake agents means locking real capital per identity; misbehavior slashes the stake. Like a harbor that admits only ships carrying verified cargo, the registry checks the stake before granting trading rights. Honest work slowly builds a crystal-clear reputation record that cannot be bought overnight, while an attacker who floods the oasis of rewards with clones must pay the full stake for each clone and loses it when caught, making Sybil attacks expensive and unprofitable.
